name: Sudden Etherealness
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Duration 1 round + 1 round/3 levels (D)

DESCRIPTION

You speak a quiet word and you become ethereal for the duration of the spell. If at the end of the spell’s duration, you re-materialize within a solid object or in an occupied space, you are shunted off to the nearest open space, taking 1d6 points of damage per 5 feet traveled.
